command:
set -euo pipefail
RUNTIME_VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-runtime-venv-XXXXXX)
DEV_VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-dev-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$RUNTIME_VENV" "$DEV_VENV"' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$RUNTIME_VENV"
"$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
"$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" -m pip check
PYTHONPATH=backend CLAIM_TOKEN_SECRET=focused-runtime-secret "$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" - <<'PY'
from app.main import app
from app.core.config import get_claim_token_secret
assert app is not None
assert get_claim_token_secret() == "focused-runtime-secret"
PY
if "$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" -m pip show pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "pytest unexpectedly present in runtime venv" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 -m venv "$DEV_VENV"
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements-dev.txt
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m pip check
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import coverage, httpx, pytest, ruff, schemathesis
print("dev imports ok")
PY
cd backend
CLAIM_TOKEN_SECRET=focused-dev-secret "$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m pytest app/tests/core/test_config.py app/tests/services/test_admin_memory_review_transactions.py
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m ruff format --check app ../server.py
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m ruff check app ../server.py
cd ..
git diff --check
